newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney sees Q4 oper shr $1.15 to $1.25.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney sees Q4 oper shr $1.15 to $1.25.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc said on Thursday that it expects to report fourth quarter operating earnings of $1.15 to $1.20 a share -- before non-recurring charges of $175 million to $200 million related to drug store acquisitions.
Securities analysts had expected the retailer to report earnings per share of $1.48 for the quarter ending around January 1997, according to First Call's consensus estimates.
In the year-ago period, J.C. Penney reported earnings per share of $1.31 on a diluted basis.
J.C. Penney, which was not immediately available for further comment, said in a statement that its gross margins for the combined November and December periods were below its plans.

The charge is related to the integration of recent drug store acquisitions and the planned disposition of certain drug stores in North and South Carolina under an agreement with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission, the retailer said.
A J.C. Penney spokesman said the company's sales were close to its internal plans, but the company's markdowns were higher than expected.
